Container.Name: car-labels
Container.Overview: Web portal for reprinting damaged car part stickers (VAG engine ECU, BMW/Aisin gearbox TCU, generic part sticker). Pick a template, type the numbers off the old sticker, then download a PNG/PDF for a DYMO LabelWriter or A4 sticker paper. On the LAN it can also print straight to a DYMO through a CUPS container's /run/cups socket, and keep a library of saved labels.
Container.Requires: Optional: a CUPS container with the DYMO queue, sharing /run/cups as a named volume.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: saved/ (label library) and logos/ (shared logos, PNG). Owned by 99:100.

Config.Name: CUPS socket
Config.Description: The CUPS container's /run/cups (a named volume or a path). Leave the printer empty to turn printing off.

Config.Name: Printer
Config.Description: CUPS queue name. Empty = download only.

Config.Name: LAN ranges
Config.Description: Clients allowed to print and use the library. Requests with Cloudflare headers never count.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Reverse proxy addresses whose X-Forwarded-For is honoured
